name: Gentle & cozy
tone: Gentle and cozy: soft, warm words, a slow reassuring pace, small comforts, nothing scary
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. It was warm from the sun, and it smelled like toast.

name: Funny & silly
tone: Funny and silly: playful exaggeration, surprises and wordplay, comic timing, giggles on every page
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. It sneezed. Doors are not supposed to sneeze.

name: Adventurous
tone: Adventurous: brisk pace, brave choices, a sense of discovery and excitement, short punchy sentences
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. He took a deep breath, pushed hard, and stepped into the unknown.

name: Warm & heartfelt
tone: Warm and heartfelt: kindness, friendship and feelings named simply, a tender ending that lingers
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. Grandma had planted those roses. Maybe she had known all along.

name: Curious & wondering
tone: Curious and full of wonder: questions, noticing small details, awe at how the world works
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. Who could be small enough to use it? And where did it go?

name: Rhyming & bouncy
tone: Rhyming and bouncy: musical read-aloud rhythm, rhyming couplets, repetition children can join in
sample: Behind the roses, small and red, a door! "Hello?" young Milo said.

name: Calm bedtime
tone: Calm bedtime: quiet, slow and soothing, soft repetition, winding down toward sleep
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. It was quiet there. The moon was quiet too.

name: Mysterious
tone: Mysterious, but never frightening: hints and clues, a little suspense, a satisfying reveal
sample: Behind the roses, Milo found a tiny door. It had not been there yesterday. Someone had left a key.
